note: Option ids are not stored here on purpose: they change every time the column list is replaced. scripts/board.sh looks them up by name at call time.
shape: One human column. Bob's Draft Notes is where work starts and Needs you is where it comes back; everything between them moves itself. A card parked in Needs you carries a bold ACTION line and a RETURN TO line at the top of its body, naming what it wants and which column it goes back to.
